Your maps stay on this device
Orbit has no account and no cloud. To have your maps on your other devices too, keep them in a folder that a sync app or cloud drive keeps in step.

Orbit has no account and no cloud. Android\'s backup, if it\'s on, keeps the maps and settings, and pictures, sounds, videos and files while they fit, but not the history; private maps only if it\'s encrypted, as a screen lock makes it; otherwise a restore leaves them out. Export all maps keeps every map whole, private ones still private.
